faq1Q: What is the teacher-to-section ratio mandated by CBSE for affiliation?
faq1A: Under Chapter 5 of the CBSE Affiliation Bye-Laws, every affiliated school must maintain a minimum teacher-to-section ratio of 1:1.5. This means for every 10 approved class sections, the school must employ at least 15 qualified teachers, excluding non-teaching administrative staff.
faq2Q: What documents are mandatory for SARAS 5.0 Affiliation Extension?
faq2A: Mandatory documents include: Valid Building Safety Certificate from PWD/State Municipal Engineer, Fire Safety NOC from State Fire Department, Safe Drinking Water & Sanitary Certificate from Public Health Engineering Department (PHED), Land Certificate issued by DM/Collector, and EPFO monthly challan returns.
faq3Q: Is police verification mandatory for school teaching and non-teaching staff?
faq3A: Yes. Under the POCSO Act 2012 guidelines and CBSE Circular No. Aff./15/2017, all teaching, administrative, transportation, and housekeeping staff must undergo formal police verification before recruitment.
faq4Q: What are the legal requirements for employee service books in private schools?
faq4A: Chapter 13 of CBSE Affiliation Bye-Laws requires the school management to maintain standardized Service Books for every permanent and probation employee, containing attested educational certificates, medical fitness certificates, date of birth proof, leave records, annual appraisals, and EPF Form 11 details.
